condition_control.comparison_unit: same item and same repetition block
required_equal: git object database, refs, config, index and status
condition_control.git_policy: Initialize one baseline snapshot per item. Exclude root AGENTS.md in identical .git/info/exclude before snapshot. Restore the same .git and code bytes for both conditions; never remove .git to remove rule injection.
condition_control.verification: Record intended condition and actual injected user/message instructions, plus path and git hashes. A mismatch or unknown is manipulation_unknown/failed, never evidence of isolated rule effect.
condition_control.interpretation: This compares the prescribed rules as a bundle; it is not a memory effect or the isolated causal effect of any individual rule.
condition_control.path_confound_policy: Different physical directories without a verified identical model-visible path remain confounded. Prepare-only evidence cannot confirm that AGENTS was actually injected.

run_plan.randomization: shuffle all (item,condition,repetition) tuples with Python random.Random(seed); save schedule before first model call
stop_rules: Do not launch until the DSH adapter, isolation, source snapshots and fixed run budget are validated.
Abort entire batch on changed bundle, access-isolation failure, original-state change, unexpected shared-state write, or injected-condition mismatch.
Infrastructure failure remains in manifest; no automatic replacement run. Resume/retry requires a separately versioned run plan.
run_plan.analysis: Report every item and every missing/failed run by condition; no aggregate trait scores.
